description: EduGage public Figshare release (P1-P16, cleaned IDs): video-viewing sessions, engagement probes, stream availability.
rating_meaning: 1-5 = difficulty paying attention during the last minute (1 effortless, 5 heavy struggle); 'X' = external distraction (excluded); null rating = X

time_axes.t: media time, s from video start (video_timestamp_sec of the log row carrying the report)
time_axes.t_wall: wall-clock s since video t=0 (includes probe pauses / buffering)

streams.Beam: Beam eye tracker (rows with valid gaze)

coverage_definition: fraction of 1-s bins of the video's wall-clock span containing >=1 sample (RPPG/RIMU/RT share the ring packet stream; Beam counts only rows with valid gaze)

totals.window_rule: one 44 s window ending at each numeric (1-5), non-paused report in a non-training video (repo default: event_trailing, 44 s, exclude 'training')
